\section[(dialogue)]{Food and the home — a first pass}

\label{lesson:JA-R54-first-pass-food-and-the-home}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for every day and a year; age.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item the floor, a mirror, a futon, chopsticks, a kitchen
  \item a garden, a bath, a tatami mat, a shelf, a box
  \item an umbrella, a school, homework, a problem, an answer
  \item a letter, time; an hour, a name, money, a mountain
  \item a river, the sea, grass, a forest, a stone
  \item sand, a rice field, a star, a cloud; a spider, the sun
  \item an island, a wave, soil, a seed, rain; candy
  \item a cat, a horse, a cow, a bird, a bear
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The floor? (\emph{yuka}.) A mirror? (\emph{kagami}.) A futon? (\emph{futon}.) Chopsticks? (\emph{hashi}.) A kitchen? (\emph{daidokoro}.) A garden? (\emph{niwa}.) A bath? (\emph{ofuro}.) A tatami mat? (\emph{tatami}.) A shelf? (\emph{tana}.) A box? (\emph{hako}.) An umbrella? (\emph{kasa}.) A school? (\emph{gakkou}.) Homework? (\emph{shukudai}.) A problem? (\emph{mondai}.) An answer? (\emph{kotae}.) A letter? (\emph{tegami}.) Time; an hour? (\emph{jikan}.) A name? (\emph{namae}.) Money? (\emph{okane}.) A mountain? (\emph{yama}.) A river? (\emph{kawa}.) The sea? (\emph{umi}.) Grass? (\emph{kusa}.) A forest? (\emph{mori}.) A stone? (\emph{ishi}.) Sand? (\emph{suna}.) A rice field? (\emph{tanbo}.) A star? (\emph{hoshi}.) A cloud; a spider? (\emph{kumo}.) The sun? (\emph{taiyou}.) An island? (\emph{shima}.) A wave? (\emph{nami}.) Soil? (\emph{tsuchi}.) A seed? (\emph{tane}.) Rain; candy? (\emph{ame}.) A cat? (\emph{neko}.) A horse? (\emph{uma}.) A cow? (\emph{ushi}.) A bird? (\emph{tori}.) A bear? (\emph{kuma}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{School, nature and animals — a second pass}

\label{lesson:JA-R54-second-pass-school-nature-and-animals}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an insect and an ant.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an insect, an ant, a pigeon, a sheep, a deer
  \item a crab, an octopus, a squid, a turtle, a wolf
  \item a chicken, small, good, long, short
  \item tall; expensive, low, cheap, fast; early, easy; kind
  \item sweet, bitter, wide, narrow, heavy
  \item strong, weak, beautiful, blue, red
  \item white, black, green, thick, warm
  \item cold, tasty, hot, cold, morning
  \item evening, tomorrow, now, every day, a year; age
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An insect? (\emph{mushi}.) An ant? (\emph{ari}.) A pigeon? (\emph{hato}.) A sheep? (\emph{hitsuji}.) A deer? (\emph{shika}.) A crab? (\emph{kani}.) An octopus? (\emph{tako}.) A squid? (\emph{ika}.) A turtle? (\emph{kame}.) A wolf? (\emph{ookami}.) A chicken? (\emph{niwatori}.) Small? (\emph{chiisai}.) Good? (\emph{ii}.) Long? (\emph{nagai}.) Short? (\emph{mijikai}.) Tall; expensive? (\emph{takai}.) Low? (\emph{hikui}.) Cheap? (\emph{yasui}.) Fast; early? (\emph{hayai}.) Easy; kind? (\emph{yasashii}.) Sweet? (\emph{amai}.) Bitter? (\emph{nigai}.) Wide? (\emph{hiroi}.) Narrow? (\emph{semai}.) Heavy? (\emph{omoi}.) Strong? (\emph{tsuyoi}.) Weak? (\emph{yowai}.) Beautiful? (\emph{utsukushii}.) Blue? (\emph{aoi}.) Red? (\emph{akai}.) White? (\emph{shiroi}.) Black? (\emph{kuroi}.) Green? (\emph{midori}.) Thick? (\emph{futoi}.) Warm? (\emph{atatakai}.) Cold? (\emph{tsumetai}.) Tasty? (\emph{oishii}.) Hot? (\emph{atsui}.) Cold? (\emph{samui}.) Morning? (\emph{asa}.) Evening? (\emph{yuugata}.) Tomorrow? (\emph{ashita}.) Now? (\emph{ima}.) Every day? (\emph{mainichi}.) A year; age? (\emph{toshi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
